models.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Maya-S
models.about: experts IQ2_XXS / IQ3_XXS, the first and last four layers IQ2_S / IQ3_S, dense weights Q8_0, the Engram tables Q6_K

models.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Maya-XS
models.about: every routed expert IQ1_S (error-feedback rounding, calibrated layer by layer on the quantized model itself), dense weights Q8_0, the Engram tables Q6_K; with its own 2-bit DSpark drafter

models.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 UD-Q4_K_XL
models.about: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 as unsloth's GGUFs for maya-ds4 (maya.py's DeepSeek setup, tools/ds4/pack_gguf.py): dense weights BF16 (UD-Q8_K_XL) or Q8_0 (UD-Q4_K_XL), routed experts MXFP4, the Engram tables MXFP8 - every file pinned to a revision, with its size and sha256. Neither has the DSpark drafter or the vision tower ("drafter" and "vision" below: from DeepSeek's own checkpoint).

models.name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 UD-Q8_K_XL
models.about: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 as unsloth's GGUFs for maya-ds4 (maya.py's DeepSeek setup, tools/ds4/pack_gguf.py): dense weights BF16 (UD-Q8_K_XL) or Q8_0 (UD-Q4_K_XL), routed experts MXFP4, the Engram tables MXFP8 - every file pinned to a revision, with its size and sha256. Neither has the DSpark drafter or the vision tower ("drafter" and "vision" below: from DeepSeek's own checkpoint).

models.name: flint Q8_0
models.about: RecursiveSI's Flint Preview as unsloth's 8-bit Q8_0 GGUF, one file, run by our flint engine; its card is made from the GGUF once it is verified. Licence: apache-2.0 (its model card).

models.name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B Q8_0
models.about: Google's Gemma 4 26B-A4B instruct as unsloth's 8-bit Q8_0 GGUF with its MTP draft file (always fetched with it), run by our Gemma 4 engine; its card is made from the GGUF and drafts with the MTP file while its MTP option is on. Licence: apache-2.0 (its model card).

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash Maya-L
models.about: Maya-L, Project Maya's largest quant: error-feedback-rounded IQ3_S gate/up experts, IQ4_XS down projections (Q5_K in the most sensitive layers), Q6_K attention, the MTP draft block, made from Z.ai's FP8 release

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash Maya-M
models.about: Maya-M, Project Maya's larger quant: error-feedback-rounded IQ2_S gate/up experts, IQ3_XXS down projections (IQ3_S in the most sensitive layers), Q6_K attention, the MTP draft block, made from Z.ai's FP8 release

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash Maya-M-Derisked
models.about: Maya-M-Derisked, Maya-M with a directional weight edit by Blackfrost_AI that reduces blanket refusals: the same IQ2_S quant, files and size, some of its weights changed (experimental)

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash Maya-S-v2-IQ2_XXS
models.about: Maya-S, Project Maya's compact quant: error-feedback-rounded IQ2_XXS gate/up experts, IQ2_S/IQ3_XXS down projections, Q6_K attention, the MTP draft block, made from Z.ai's FP8 release

models.name: GLM-5.3-Flash Maya-S24
models.about: Maya-S24, Maya-S with Q4_K attention and shared experts: about 1.5 GB less that stays on the GPU, so 24 GB cards hold more experts (decode about 14% faster there, 11% on 32 GB), close to Maya-S in quality

models.name: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash Maya-S
models.about: routed experts IQ2_XXS, the most sensitive IQ2_XS / IQ2_S / IQ3_XXS (~2.1 bits); attention and indexers Q8_0, the rest Q6_K

models.name: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash Maya-XS
models.about: routed experts IQ1_S, the most sensitive IQ2_XXS (~1.6 bits); attention Q5_K / Q6_K, indexers Q8_0, the rest Q5_K, embedding Q4_K, head Q6_K

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Q8_0
models.about: 8-bit, the closest to the full model

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-Q4_K_XL
models.about: 4-bit (Unsloth Dynamic), the smallest

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B UD-Q6_K_XL
models.about: 6-bit (Unsloth Dynamic), closer to the full model

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder IQ1_M
models.about: the Coder's only size: half the experts, stored like IQ3_S (3.5 bits)

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Gyro) Gyro-M
models.about: about IQ3_XXS quality with about 20% less GPU memory (35 GB of VRAM + RAM together); decodes about 16-21% slower than Q2_0 on 12 GB cards

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Gyro) Gyro-S
models.about: the smallest option, for PCs with little memory (27.6 GB of VRAM + RAM together); lower quality than the 2-3-bit sizes, and the 2-bit Q2_0 decodes faster

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ2_XS
models.about: 2-bit i-quant, a little better quality, close in speed

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S
models.about: 3.5-bit i-quant, the best quality (matches the full model), the slowest; needs a 64 GB PC with little else running

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_XXS
models.about: 3-bit i-quant, better quality, slower (more CPU work per token)

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q2_0
models.about: 2-bit, the fastest

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Unsloth) Q8_0
models.about: 8-bit, the reference quality (every expert Q8_0); for a 192 GB PC

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Unsloth) UD-IQ4_XS
models.about: ~4-bit i-quant (Unsloth Dynamic), between IQ3_S and UD-Q4_K_XL in quality; on a PC with less than ~80 GB of RAM part of its experts are read from the SSD

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Unsloth) UD-Q4_K_XL
models.about: 4-bit (Unsloth Dynamic): K-quant experts, between UD-IQ4_XS and UD-Q5_K_XL in quality

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Unsloth) UD-Q5_K_XL
models.about: 5-bit (Unsloth Dynamic): Q5_K experts with Q8_0 downs, close to Q8_0 in quality

models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (Unsloth) UD-Q6_K_XL
models.about: 6-bit (Unsloth Dynamic): Q6_K experts with Q8_0 downs

models.name: raon-1-mini Q8_0
models.about: KRAFTON's Raon-1-mini preview as its own 8-bit Q8_0 GGUF, one file, run by our raon1 engine; strata-prepare packs it first (Maya's step with our raon1 port), then its card appears. Licence: apache-2.0 (its model card).

models.name: Swift 1.5 IQ2_XS
models.about: 2-bit i-quant, a little better quality, close in speed

models.name: Swift 1.5 IQ3_S
models.about: 3.5-bit i-quant, the best quality (matches the full model), the slowest; needs a 64 GB PC with little else running

models.name: Swift 1.5 IQ3_XXS
models.about: 3-bit i-quant, better quality, slower (more CPU work per token)
